subject: Pilot qualification recap & measurement slate
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@serviq.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot qualification recap & measurement slate

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a concrete measurement slate so we can align on what a successful pilot looks like for ServIQ. I kept this intentionally short with explicit asks.

Summary of the ask: ServIQ wants a 6-week pilot that proves the model in production-like traffic for the customer-facing summarization flow. You asked for success criteria across latency, throughput, cost, and output quality. Below is our proposed slate and next steps.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end response < 350 ms for the summarization API under realistic concurrency spikes.
- Throughput: sustain 250-300 requests/sec at 99% availability during the soak window.
- Cost: average token cost <= $0.002/token when using recommended batching + KV cache profile.
- Quality: task-level accuracy >= 88% on labeled sample; hallucination rate < 2% on a held-out set; human evaluation: >= 90 NPS-like satisfaction across 150 blind reviews.

Evaluation plan (high level):
1) Week 0-1: onboarding & data ingestion (Monica lead) — instrumentation hooks + baseline perf capture.
2) Week 2: synthetic traffic run & smoke validation (Ben to set infra + metrics) — verify latency/throughput targets.
3) Week 3-4: production-shaped soak (72-hour continuous run) with live traffic replay.
4) Week 5: quality evaluation — automated metrics + human blind review on 150 samples.
5) Week 6: readout & sign-off.

Acceptance gates:
- Gate A: Smoke pass (p95 latency < 500ms, no data loss) to move to soak.
- Gate B: Soak pass (p95 < 350ms, throughput target met) + automated quality thresholds.
- Final: Human-eval pass + stakeholder sign-off.

Owner map (proposed):
- Onboarding & data: Monica Patel (monica@redwood.ai)
- Instrumentation & infra: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.ai)
- Evaluation & quality scoring: Rafael Mendes (rafael@redwood.ai) + ServIQ SMEs

Attachments: attached a metrics template and SOW draft to make scope explicit (redwood-pilot-metrics-template.xlsx, sow-draft-v1.pdf).

Please reply by end of day Friday with any changes to the acceptance thresholds or owners. If that looks good, I'll send a short calendar invite for the kickoff (30 mins) and a link to the Drive folder where we'll collect evaluation artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to running this together.

—
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai

Thanks Rafael — this is very helpful and much appreciated. A few quick adjustments from our side after internal sync: 

- Quality bar: can we make the human-eval target 92% to reflect our compliance reviewers' threshold? We can compromise at 91% if necessary, but we wanted to flag it.
- Cost: our finance team prefers cost/token reported both as raw and normalized by average prompt length; can you include both in the template?
- Timeline: instead of a straight 6 weeks, we prefer a 7-week window to account for legal sign-off on data ingestion.

Next steps for us: I'll loop in our security lead if onboarding requires any additional attestations (SOC view). If you can update the template and SOW with the two quality options (90/92) and the cost normalization column, we'll review and aim to confirm owners next week.

Also — happy to take the kickoff meeting next Tuesday 10am PT if that works for your team.

Olivia Grant
Head of Product, ServIQ
olivia@serviq.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pilot qualification recap & measurement slate

Olivia — thanks for the quick read. All sensible asks. Adjustments below and a few more concrete measurement details so folks can implement instrumentation and dashboards without ambiguity.

Updated items:
- Quality: we'll add both columns in the template: Target (>= 92%) and Stretch (>= 94%). Final sign-off can pick Target vs Stretch.
- Cost normalization: will include "cost/token" and "cost/avg_prompt" (USD) calculations in the sheet.
- Timeline: updated plan to 7 weeks to allow legal and security checks. New milestone dates below.

Concrete measurement slate (final):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for request-level RTT; p95 target <= 350 ms (measured at API ingress), alert at p95 > 400 ms.
- Throughput: 5-minute rolling RPS and error-rate breakdown; target sustain 250-300 RPS with 99% success rate.
- Cost: tokenized cost + normalized cost/avg_prompt; include pre/post batching estimates and realized cost during soak window.
- Quality: automated metrics (accuracy/F1 on labeled set), hallucination rate via heuristics, and blind human eval. Target >= 92% on human eval for Target gate.

Evaluation steps (more detail):
1) Onboarding (Week 0): data push, schema check, access controls. Monica lead — checklist in Drive.
2) Instrumentation (Week 1): generate traces, ensure metrics exported to Prometheus -> Grafana. Ben lead.
3) Smoke & tuning (Week 2): warm-up model, tune batch sizes and cache TTLs, verify p95 under 500ms.
4) Soak (Week 3-5): 72-hour continuous run under production-shaped replay + surge tests. Capture cost and quality signals.
5) Blind human eval (Week 6): 150 random samples, double-blind reviews with inter-rater agreement check.
6) Readout & sign-off (Week 7): results + SOW attachment updates.

Owner matrix (finalized):
- Program manager (serves as single point): Olivia Grant (ServIQ)
- Redwood onboarding & data: Monica Patel (monica@redwood.ai)
- Infra/instrumentation: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.ai)
- Evaluation lead: Rafael Mendes (rafael@redwood.ai)

Action items (Rafael):
- Update metrics template with normalized cost column + both quality targets (today EOD).
- Send kickoff invite for Tue at 10am PT (tentative).
- Ben to share dashboard links and a Prometheus job spec.

If that aligns, please hit reply with a one-line confirmation. If anything else, call out items you want prioritized for the first week.

Thanks —
Rafael
